title: A Claude pipe connect timeout escapes as TimeoutException, so a send that wrote nothing settles Uncertain/submission_failed instead of a deferral or refusal
fix_direction: Map TimeoutException from the connect stage (before userWriteStarted) to a pre-write transport failure in NativePeerAdapter.SendAsync, preferably Held so it defers, or at least Refused native_transport_unavailable, and add a fake-connect test that throws TimeoutException.

title: Every discovery pass re-runs WinVerifyTrust and a full SHA-256 over each unpinned session's claude.exe (236-327 MB here); only the pinned path is cached
fix_direction: Cache the unpinned observation (trust verdict and hash) by (pid, StartFileTime, full path) as the pinned path does, evicting with the live-pid sweep; the send-time ClaudePublisherImageTrust check still re-verifies the connected image.

title: A forward to a paired broker that is briefly unreachable (connection refused, connect timeout, worker restarting, laptop asleep) ends Uncertain/submission_unconfirmed and is never forwarded again, though nothing was sent and the peer's Accept would take a retry by message ID
fix_direction: In the paired-broker branch, treat a failure proven to be before the request (HttpRequestException with HttpRequestError.ConnectionError, or a connect timeout) as DeferredNotSubmitted and release the claim, relying on the peer's idempotent Accept for any later retry.

title: A store commit that fails with Win32Exception after a submission (CompleteDelivery or ReleaseUnsubmittedClaim) escapes DeliverAsync, GuardAsync restarts the loop as non-fatal, and the claim stays Submitting, holding every later message to that recipient until restart or ExpiresAt + 24 h
fix_direction: Have AtomicFile.ReplaceExisting (or BrokerStore.ReplaceFile) raise the MoveFileEx failure as an IOException, or add Win32Exception to GuardAsync's durable-state list, so a failed commit after a submission exits and the restart settles the claim Uncertain; also add a test that fails the commit after a submission.

title: The federation request body is capped at 32,768 bytes AFTER default System.Text.Json escaping, while Accept admits 16 KiB of UTF-8 text, so an admitted message whose escaped JSON passes 32 KiB is never forwarded and is recorded Uncertain/submission_unconfirmed with no notice and no retry
fix_direction: Raise the federation body cap on both client and server to cover the worst case (MaximumTextBytes*6 plus envelope), or use a relaxed encoder and size-check the escaped body at Accept for peer-bound messages, and settle a body refused before sending as Refused with its own reason, not Uncertain; add a Network test forwarding a 16 KiB escaped-worst-case message.

title: Log mode ('Just keep a log of what was approved', documented as no pet commentary) still chimes and animates the pet for every blocked transcript prompt and every prompt read off the screen, because Deliver gates only speech on the mode; the pane greys out the sound and animation boxes in Log mode, so the user cannot see or change what is firing
fix_direction: Gate wantsSound and wantsAnimation on AgentMode.Speaks(Mode) in Deliver (Log keeps only the log line), and extend the Log-mode self-check to tick sound and animation and assert no chime and no animation.

title: The session-limit watch types pause-and-resume messages into Claude Code panels in Log mode ('Never speaks, never presses'), because the only gate is the answering port and the pauseAtLimit setting, while the pane greys that checkbox out in Log mode so it cannot be unticked there
fix_direction: Snapshot the mode with the settings and pass pauseAtLimit && AgentMode.Speaks(mode) to WatchSessionLimit, re-check the mode in the per-panel last look before SendPause, and add a Log-mode case to the session-limit self-test asserting no send.

title: The --audit release gate prints the expected 'audit OK' and exits 0 when it extracted ZERO option strings from the bundle, and exits 0 when no bundle is found, so it passes with nothing compared
fix_direction: Make the audit fail or print DEGRADED (non-zero) when no bundle is found or when the extracted set lacks the anchor labels the table knows must exist (e.g. 'Yes' and 'No'), and add a selftest case that feeds a bundle with no extractable labels.

title: Refresh cloud models (and Refresh local models) take the pending-aware delegate but read only the radio from it: the listing runs against the SAVED provider, endpoint and key, so an unapplied provider switch lists the wrong catalogue and a first-time cloud setup is told to select the provider it just selected
fix_direction: Build the detached PendingSettings(s, pending) copy (as the other pending-aware actions do) and list against its provider/endpoint/key and local backend kind/endpoint.

title: The CLI card's "Goes through" privacy row understates what leaves the machine: it names the persona and the front window's title, but every remark also sends the title of the window the companion stands on and up to four other running app names, and the "screenshot of the window" falls back to the whole monitor
fix_direction: Rewrite the row from what DescribeScreenContext and ChooseCaptureBounds actually send (both window titles, background app names, window-or-whole-monitor screenshot) and pin it to those functions in the probe.

title: Choosing the 'custom' cloud provider and typing its base URL in the same Apply drops the URL (the provider switch loads the remembered custom URL, empty the first time, and the typed field is skipped on a switch); with a key typed too, the whole Apply is refused as 'Select a provider and valid endpoint'
fix_direction: When the new provider is 'custom', honour a non-blank typed cloudEndpoint even on a switch (UpdateSelectedProviderEndpoint after SelectProviderEndpoint), before the key is scoped.

title: IsRetryable treats a connection dropped after the response headers (IOException/HttpIOException from the body read) as deterministic, so the brain does not retry and the cloud-to-local fallover never runs
fix_direction: Treat IOException (including HttpIOException) as retryable in IsRetryable when the caller's token is not cancelled, and add a probe that throws it from the content stream.

title: IHost.RegisterHotkey has no failure channel and no caller id, and the host turns a combo Windows refuses into a silent no-op handle with no log line, so a module hotkey that another application already holds (or that does not parse) simply never fires and neither the module nor the user is told
fix_direction: Log the refused or unparseable combo in CompanionHost.RegisterHotkey (naming the combo and the Win32 error). Add an optional post-freeze interface or result so a module can show 'hotkey unavailable' in its pane.

title: ShimejiEngine.RoundTrips never compares the reparsed document with the original, so a lossy DTO serialization reports "ok" although its doc comment says this is where unfaithful DTOs show up first
fix_direction: After the reparse, require Serialize(reparsed) to equal the first serialization ordinally (as PackConversion.Prepare does) and compare the original document with the emitted one semantically (element/attribute sets after normalisation), reporting the first difference.

title: The classic converter resolves a pose Sound by file NAME anywhere under a search root that can span the whole pack, so in a multi-character pack one character's pet silently embeds another character's clip of the same name
fix_direction: Pass the image-set name to SoundBaker and resolve in the source's order (sound/<Sound>, sound/<set>/<Sound>, img/<set>/sound/<Sound>), keying the cache on the relative path plus set, with name-only search kept only as a reported fallback; add a two-set fixture to SoundResolveSelfTest.

title: A bundle manifest's sprites.basePath (and filePattern) is joined to the bundle folder with no containment check, so an absolute, UNC or ../ value makes the converter open files outside the bundle, including on a remote SMB share
fix_direction: Resolve basePath and each sprite name with GetFullPath and require the result under the bundle root (refuse rooted, UNC, drive-qualified and reparse-point paths, as TickPackEmitter does), applied in ResolveSpritesDir and WebPLoader.ForDirectory, with self-test cases for a UNC, absolute and ../ basePath and filePattern.

title: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md's 'runtime inventory' is the .NET Framework 4.8-era list: 19 of its 24 rows are in no lock file and 17 are referenced by no project (OnnxRuntime is Fortunes' own PackageReference, unlocked), the DOTNET_* legal files it says the payload retains are produced by nothing, and the third-party packages the shipped modules do carry (Ical.Net 5.2.3, NAudio.Wasapi, ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore 2.2.0) are not listed at all
fix_direction: Regenerate the inventory from the real lock and project graph, drop the net48-era rows and the DOTNET_* claims, list Ical.Net, NodaTime and NAudio.Wasapi with their licences, and package their licence and NOTICE files in the Reminder and Remembrance module ZIPs.

title: The production smart-index warm creates its ONNX session with default options, so every cold warm embeds the pool on an intra-op pool sized to all cores; the all-core cost the 2026-10-01 campaign removed from the self-tests (by turning smart picks off in the fakes) is still the shipped behaviour on the user's machine
fix_direction: Create the session with SessionOptions capping IntraOpNumThreads (e.g. 1-2), InterOpNumThreads=1 and spinning off (session.intra_op.allow_spinning=0), and record the choice in the register.

title: Four of the six VectorCache adversarial cases (wrong-dimension, oversized-count, oversized-key, oversized file) are rejected by a different guard than the one they name, so removing the dimension, entry-count, key-length or file-size guard leaves vector_cache=PASS
fix_direction: Make each fixture otherwise valid so only its named guard can refuse it (full matching payload for wrong-dimension, a length-consistent count fixture, a valid-magic oversized file, a printable over-long key), then mutation-test each guard.

title: OutputFailureIsObserved ignores EnsureStartedForTest's result, so a build that answers a dead chosen device by muting ALL sound for RetryInterval passes every check, though the label at :446 claims 'the next sound goes to the default'
fix_direction: Assert EnsureStartedForTest() == true and RunningDevice == Guid.Empty after the chosen device's asynchronous failure. TryStart(Guid.Empty) succeeds synchronously even on a device-less runner, so this is deterministic. Mutation-test it with MarkUnavailable added to the chosen branch.

title: With the debug window open, right-clicking any tick (Shimeji) companion throws KeyNotFoundException out of PictureBox1_MouseDown: the tick routing returns only for the LEFT button, so the classic debug menu runs and looks up CurrentAnimation.ID 0, which no validated pet has
fix_direction: Return before the classic right-button handling when TickHost != null, or build a tick-aware debug menu. Use SheepAnimations.TryGetValue in GetNextAnimations and in the menu's name lookups.

title: A tick companion's speech bubble is anchored at the classic engine's PositionX/PositionY/OffsetY, which nothing on the tick path ever sets, so the bubble appears near the virtual screen origin instead of over the companion, and RenderTick's 'follow' re-pins it there every tick
fix_direction: In RenderTick set PositionX=left, PositionY=top, OffsetY=0 and the facing from the mascot's LookRight (or have GetSpeechAnchor use Left/Top when TickHost != null), and add a window self-test asserting the bubble anchors over a moved tick companion.

title: The fullscreen scan reads GetWindowRect (with the invisible resize border), so a MAXIMISED window on a monitor whose taskbar reserves no space reads as fullscreen and stands every companion there down
fix_direction: In Offer/BlockedMonitors, stop a maximized captioned window (IsZoomed plus WS_CAPTION/WS_THICKFRAME) from deciding a monitor as blocked; do not rely on DWM bounds alone. Add a self-test case where a maximized window covers a no-taskbar monitor.

title: HotkeyRegistrarSmoke's 'returns a handle for a valid combo' cannot fail: CompanionHost.RegisterHotkey returns a non-null Noop for a refused registration AND for any exception, so a registrar that never registers anything passes
fix_direction: Assert the returned handle is the registered Remover, not Noop, and that a second registration of the same combo is refused while the first is held, reporting SKIP only when Win32 says the combo is taken.

title: asm.GetTypes() runs before the MinHostVersion gate, so a too-new module whose assembly holds any type implementing a contract interface this host lacks fails with ReflectionTypeLoadException and NeedsNewerHost=false instead of 'needs host X'
fix_direction: Stay fail-closed per F342, but on ReflectionTypeLoadException look up the IModule type in ex.Types (or read MinHostVersion before GetTypes) and file a NeedsNewerHost refusal when the gate is unsatisfied; add a fixture module with a double implementing an interface the host lacks.

title: SafeScript bounds parse work (4096 chars, 1024 tokens, depth 32) but nothing bounds the values an evaluation builds: '+' concatenates strings of any length and mascot.variables accepts any number of keys, so a pack expression can grow memory without limit across ticks
fix_direction: Bound evaluation results: refuse (as a ScriptFault) a '+' result or a stored string over a fixed cap, and cap mascot.variables' key count per companion.

title: Every ICO preflight check accepts any refusal whose message contains 'ICO' case-insensitively, and every icon error starts 'pet icon', so the checks cannot tell which rule refused; removing the entry-count bound still passes
fix_direction: Have each case assert its own message ('excessive ICO directory entry count', 'overlapping ICO payloads', 'out-of-range ICO payload', 'directory/payload dimension mismatch'), and size the entry-count fixture so only the count rule can refuse it.

title: ReloadPetType counts session-only born companions as pets to respawn, then respawns them as chosen pets and persists them into the saved mix
fix_direction: Skip bornPets in ReloadPetType's live count and in the removals it makes, then either leave the born companions running on the old pair or retire them explicitly, so only chosen pets are respawned and persisted.

title: A failed 'Use this companion' re-arms the startup spawn timer, so every pet of the saved mix is spawned again on top of the pets still on screen
fix_direction: Record timer1's Tag/Enabled before Stop and restore it in the catch. Re-arm 'A' only when CloseAllPetsImmediate has already run.

title: The 'settings window must not wait on a sleeping NAS' block asserts the deadline on ProbeBounded alone; nothing checks that FileExistsBounded or DescribeNotificationSound (the path Preferences' Load takes) still go through it, so making them unbounded again passes every check
fix_direction: Give FileExistsBounded/DescribeNotificationSound a probe seam, or a source invariant that FileExistsBounded calls ProbeBounded and DescribeNotificationSound calls FileExistsBounded. Drive DescribeNotificationSound with a blocking probe and assert both the deadline and the 'did not answer' text.

title: The Modules pane's Install and Reinstall buttons are laid out but never pressed by any runtime check, and ModulesPaneProbe cannot press them: InstallModuleAsync bypasses the DownloadVerified, StagingRoot and MarkForUpdate seams the probe isolates, so the whole install and reinstall flow is covered only by an order regex
fix_direction: Route InstallModuleAsync through _seams (DownloadVerified, StagingRoot, MarkForUpdate). Add ModulesPaneProbe cases that press Install and Reinstall and assert the move into modules/<id>, the update marker and the status text.

title: A corrupt settings.json is recovered from the backup or replaced by DEFAULTS with no message: LastLoadWarning is never set on that path and LastRecoveryFile is read only by CoreTests
fix_direction: When PreserveCorruptPrimary preserved a file, set a recovery notice naming the preserved file and whether the backup or the defaults were used. Show it at startup with wording separate from the 'storage unavailable' box.

title: After a successful Apply on a schema pane with no Info or Header field, the view keeps its pre-Apply baseline, so changing a field BACK to what it was before the Apply leaves Apply greyed and the reverted value can never be saved
fix_direction: After a successful Save on a pane that is not rebuilt, rebase the view's baseline (_stored and _shownAtBuild from Collect(), and the deferred list cards' wasChecked) to what was just written.

title: The tag-triggered release publishes the ZIP, MSI and nupkgs without running any of the product's tests or self-tests, and nothing ties it to a green build.yml run for the tagged commit
fix_direction: Gate release.yml on the tagged commit's build.yml result (query the check-runs for the tag sha and refuse unless green, with an explicit documented override for the MinHostVersion exception), or run the core test and self-test steps in release.yml before publishing.

title: REINSTALLMODE=amus does not reach the MSI's own UI repair: the stock WixUI Repair button publishes ReinstallMode=ecmus, which overrides the Property-table value, and Test-MsiSurface.ps1 asserts only the Property row, so the check passes while the UI repair is not a force-copy
fix_direction: Override the stock VerifyReadyDlg Repair ControlEvent to publish ReinstallMode=amus (a Publish with a higher Order on Dialog=VerifyReadyDlg Control=Repair), extend Test-MsiSurface to assert the ControlEvent argument contains 'a', and correct the wxs comment.

title: A capture that dies mid-recording (headset unplugged, Bluetooth drop, endpoint invalidated) is surfaced only at Stop, in the log: the Status line keeps saying Recording while that track captures nothing for the rest of the meeting, and with two deaths only the last is reported
fix_direction: Have the RecordingStopped handler record a per-source live failure (a TrackWriteFailure-style entry the tick already surfaces on the Status line and in the log) and keep one entry per source instead of one overwritten string.

title: The local summary path sends the whole transcript to whatever 'Local Ollama address' holds, over plain http to a remote host if typed, and still stamps the file 'local Ollama; nothing left this machine'
fix_direction: Run the address through the same rule as AiEndpointPolicy (plain http only to loopback, https elsewhere) and write the header from the actual host, keeping 'nothing left this machine' for loopback only; correct the class doc.

title: A recording saved at app exit is never transcribed and nothing ever says so where the user looks: no stub transcript is written, the next start does not notice, and the 72-hour purge then deletes the only copy of the meeting
fix_direction: On the shutdown branch, write the stub transcript beside recording.wav (Transcriber's '[Transcription pending]' text, no whisper run) and at Init surface any capture whose audio has no transcript on the Status line before the purge can reach it.

title: 'Run the follow-up on the latest summary' picks the newest *.summary.md or *.summary.txt in ANY subfolder of the storage root, not only folders Remembrance wrote, and sends it to the CLI vendor before the user sees which file it chose
fix_direction: Walk only capture-shaped and day-shaped subfolders (and module-shaped names at the root), as the purge does, and name the chosen file before sending.

title: 'Transcribe a WAV file...' on a capture's own WAV overwrites its existing transcript with the '[Transcription pending]' stub when the new whisper run fails
fix_direction: When whisper did not run and the target transcript already exists, leave it untouched and report the failure (or write the stub to a separate name / keep a .bak); only replace on success.

title: whisper-cli is never cancelled or killed when the app or module shuts down, so it outlives the process for up to 6 hours and its transcript is orphaned
fix_direction: Put whisper-cli in a kill-on-close job object (as AiBrain does) or track and kill it from Shutdown/HostShutdown. Write the '[Transcription pending]' stub before running whisper so an interrupted run still leaves a transcript pointing at re-transcription.

title: Outlook, .ics and Zoom feeds drop a meeting two minutes after it STARTS, so meeting.current, the Join tray entry and Remembrance's record offer go blank a few minutes into every meeting
fix_direction: Window on END rather than START. For Outlook use '[End] >= from AND [Start] <= to'; for Zoom keep s + duration >= from; for .ics check that ongoing occurrences survive. Add a self-check with a meeting that started 10 minutes before 'now'.

title: The F204 unbounded fired-set growth returns through the Zoom slot: marks mirrored into cal5, and cal5's own marks, are never pruned while the Zoom slot sits in a steady warning or error
fix_direction: Mirror into cal5 only while cal5 is healthy, or age-prune ids of an unhealthy slot using the start minute in the event id. Add a self-check with a steady-error Zoom slot and a calendar copy that leaves.

title: The sound self-test checks AppTickAudio.Volume in isolation and swaps the sink for RecordingAudio, so the production composition AppTickAudio.Play (TickAudio.cs:86-91, wired at StartUp.cs:738) and AudioOutput.PlayClip (AudioOutput.cs:301-312) run under no self-test or harness
fix_direction: Drive AppTickAudio.Play with a held predicate returning true against a recording AudioOutput seam (or pin the _held() argument and the StartUp.cs:738 wiring in a source invariant with a mutation case) so dropping the fullscreen hold for tick clips fails.

title: Render (and Step's window opening) find a companion's sprites by type NAME, while the companion keeps the TickType object it was built with; after a reload re-stages that name, a companion still running the old TickType is drawn from the NEW sheet with the OLD pose geometry, and an out-of-range frame or region throws out of the tick timer, where nothing catches it
fix_direction: Look up the drawn and running host type by object (HostTypeOf(m.PoseType ?? m.Type)) in Render and Step, and wrap each companion's render in a catch that reports and disposes that companion as TickMascot.Tick does.

title: Behaviour selection recurses without a bound: when every candidate behaviour's action cannot start, TickBehaviour.Init and TickMascot.SetBehaviour call each other until the UI thread's stack overflows, which kills the whole app (a StackOverflowException cannot be caught), although Seek bounds the same class of loop for Sequences
fix_direction: Count consecutive init hand-offs on the mascot (reset when an action starts). Past a small bound, report a fault and throw TickCantBeAliveException so the companion is disposed with 'error', as Seek does for Sequences.

title: Install pack reads _pack again after its modal replace question, so a pack import that lands while the question is open is installed with the PREVIOUS pack's replace map, writing its members over the previous pack's installed ids
fix_direction: Capture _pack/_packTitle before the question and install the captured pack only if _pack is still the same object afterwards; also refuse Install pack (and Preview pack) while _importing.

title: The rediscovery address-policy checks use hints that can never reach broker b, so deleting the NetworkPolicy check on reconnect hints leaves all four green
fix_direction: Point each bad hint at b's real port (http<local path> port>/, htt<local path> HTTP port>/, http<local path> port>/other) so a policy bypass would increment b.Pairing.InfoRequests, and add direct NetworkPolicy.Endpoint refusal checks for each clause.

title: The reconnect-shutdown check only times Node.DisposeAsync, so it stays green when federation disposal neither cancels nor joins the reconnect loop
fix_direction: Assert a real witness: b's BeforeInfo observing RequestAborted before a's identity and store are disposed, or the reconnect task reaching RanToCompletion or Canceled (via an internal accessor) once Federation.DisposeAsync returns.

title: The two pairing body-size checks send 40,000 NUL bytes, which fail JSON parsing anyway, so both stay green with the 32 KiB limit removed
fix_direction: Send a syntactically valid JSON body over 32 KiB (for example a request whose nonce or a padding field is 40,000 characters), and assert the refusal happens before parsing, for example by the status plus the error body or by a body that would otherwise deserialize.

title: The legacy-settings migration groups assert a migrated volume of 0.3, which is also the default the importer starts from, so deleting the userSettings (user.config) import or the whole Volume import passes CoreTests: the same vacuity the F384 comment at :466-470 fixed for backup recovery
fix_direction: Use non-default legacy volumes (for example "0.55" and "55", both expecting 0.55) in AssertLegacyVolume and TestOneTimeMigration, so dropping the import or the userSettings read changes the asserted number.

title: A clean sweep recursively deletes whatever -WorkRoot names, including a pre-existing folder and everything already in it
fix_direction: Refuse a -WorkRoot that already exists, or create a fresh standdown-ab-<guid> child under it and delete only that child, plus a prefix assertion before the recursive delete.

title: No rebuild between cases: every case after the first runs against build outputs compiled from EARLIER cases' mutants, and the rebuild proof checks only the case's own artefact, so a case can score FIRED from a previous case's mutant
fix_direction: After restoring each case's source, rebuild that case's csproj (or rebuild before the next case any artefact the previous case changed), and assert the restored artefact's hash or mtime before the next case runs.

title: The gate checks only exit codes for CoreTests and the AgentBroker harnesses, so deleting a test registration leaves every check green
fix_direction: Floor the CoreTests group count and each AgentBroker harness's assertion count in the gate (pinned like $shimejiSuiteFloor), or add a source invariant that every Test* method or *Checks entry point is registered.

title: A witness is graded FIRED when its focused test group exits 1 naming its file, but no healthy phase ever runs that group, so a group already failing on unmutated code grades every one of its mutants FIRED
fix_direction: In healthy(), run each selected witness's test_args once on unmutated code and require exit 0 with a nonzero assertion count, and ideally grade FIRED on the witness's named check rather than on the file name.

title: The 'reported PASS with no assertion lines' guard is unreachable: it counts the host's own convention PASS: lines, so a module SelfTest that asserts nothing still shows 9+ assertions
fix_direction: Count only the module's own tagged lines ('^/s*/[' + [regex]::Escape($id) + '/]/s*PASS:') for the zero-assertion rule, and mutation-test it with a SelfTest that returns true and an empty detail.

title: Any exception out of supervisor.RefreshAsync (for example Process.Start failing once) ends the supervision loop for good: the broker stays down until the user changes a setting or restarts the companion, unlike a worker that exits, which is retried with backoff

The self-test's 'shutdown ... cleans owned worker off thread' check asserts supervisor.Stops > 0, which the disabled Init run already made true before Shutdown is called, so a shutdown that never stops the worker still passes
fix_direction: Record supervisor.Stops immediately before module.Shutdown() and assert it increased after the pump, so the check names the shutdown-cancelled run's stop.

title: Connect Claude MCP tells the user an existing entry 'already exists ... Review it' even when it is exactly this broker's entry; only Codex gets the 'already configured' answer

A paired broker's own pre-delivery refusal reaches the sender, via the receipt pass, as reason recipient_receipt, so the sender's notice says 'was refused by its recipient' for a message no recipient ever saw

CompactTombstones swallows only IOException and UnauthorizedAccessException, but its ReplaceFile fallback (AtomicFile.ReplaceExisting -> MoveFileEx) throws Win32Exception, so a compaction failure escapes AFTER a successful commit and makes the committed operation look failed (or stops the store opening)
The Core README says Unknown activity permits a claim only with an explicit AtomicIdleAdmission capability; no such member has ever existed, and the gate is SessionCapabilities.NativeIdleGuard
The pipe and cc-msg regexes end in $, which .NET also matches before a final newline, so a messagingSocketPath ending in LF is accepted as canonical

The Claude adapter README still calls the library a Phase 0 prototype whose protected credential reader nothing runs, but the shipped AgentBroker worker constructs it with ProtectedPeerCredentialSource on every Claude wake send
The Claude adapter README says three exact Claude Code profiles are supported (2.1.292, 2.1.304, 2.1.306); the adapter takes its profiles from the embedded pin document, which pins seven
The Claude native pipe client opens with no impersonation level, so .NET sends no SQOS flags and the pipe server may impersonate the broker; the Codex and control pipe clients pass Identification
The smoke probe hard-codes 2.1.304 and 2.1.306 as the VS Code runtimes, so the newer pinned VS Code builds are labelled verified_standalone_runtime

Messages well inside the adapter's 32 KiB check are refused native_message_too_large on Codex, because the text is JSON-escaped three times with the default encoder and carried twice in the turn frame

The Codex external-peer turn re-quotes the already formatted peer message with System.Text.Json's default encoder, so every quote, apostrophe, backtick, angle bracket, ampersand, plus sign and non-ASCII character reaches the Codex model and the owner's GUI as a /uXXXX escape
fix_direction: Pass JsonSerializerOptions with JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping to ToJsonString at NativeExternalPeerInput.cs:33, and add a Desktop test asserting the visible text contains the raw quote and Unicode characters rather than /u escapes.

title: On an exactly pinned extension, every 10-second discovery pass re-hashes the full codex.exe engine image once per running VS Code engine (the same file N times) plus every pinned bundle
Every NativePeerAdapter refusal reaches the receipt as native_admission_refused, and a transient pipe failure before any write is a final Refused
Discovery takes the 32 lowest PIDs named claude before filtering, so sessions beyond them vanish with no diagnostic, and non-session claude.exe processes use up slots
One conversation's owner_capability_mismatch fails the whole Codex discovery pass and clears every binding, although the provider deliberately treats it as a per-conversation answer
fix_direction: If a pinned router can host a capability-less owner, skip that row (list it without capabilities, as the publisher-signed branch does) instead of failing the pass, and record the change against the P3-5 rule in DESIGN-REGISTER.

title: CompleteDiscovery ignores its carriedBindings argument since 615e798, so the adapter's per-row 'carried' list (an extra Authorize call per guarded row) is built for nothing

A Code-owned codex.exe exiting between the process snapshot and its metadata read is classified as a verdict, so the submission is finally Refused (and a discovery pass drops every row's capabilities) instead of deferring as a transient check

The worker adapters README says a Claude session's status is Unknown when updatedAt is older than 2 minutes; the code has no age limit (old idle stays valid), as the ClaudeAdapter's own VERIFICATION.md says
A fatal durable-state failure stops the worker with exit code 0 and records its reason only in the status of the process that is exiting, so nobody can see why the broker went down
The firewall setup's block-rule check ignores block rules that apply to every program, so it reports Allowed while such a rule still blocks the LAN port
The broker's TLS identity expires five years after creation and nothing renews it, so the worker then refuses to start on every launch

When any Grant self-test check fails, the finally's non-recursive Delete of the fixture folder throws 'directory is not empty' and replaces the failing check's code, and the fixture (synthetic settings plus private-ACL backups) is left in tools/agentbroker, which is not gitignored

Every refusal of the grant (CLI pin mismatch, concurrent edit, missing ~/.claude, unsupported or linked settings.json) collapses into one reason-less message, and the dry run never checks the CLI pin, so after any Claude Code update the dry run says ChangeNeeded=True and -Apply always fails without saying why

The installer's -SelfTest (archive path policy, hard-link refusal, marker compare-and-swap, stage collisions, runtime rollback, per-version MCP tool contracts) is run by no test, gate or CI step; the same holds for the Grant, Inspect-ClaudeMcpPolicy, Inspect-ClaudeMcpEntry and Probe-IsolatedClaudeMcpSetup self-tests

The self-test's 'Atomic new-settings publication' and 'Atomic settings collision refusal' checks call [IO.Directory]::Move on their own synthetic folders and never reach the installer's settings publication, so they pass whatever the installer does

The installer self-test's cleanup deletes only a fixed list of expected paths and then the test root non-recursively, so the very regressions its checks look for leave an unlisted folder behind and the final Delete replaces the check's message with 'directory is not empty'
-StageUpdate refuses every installation whose broker has LAN turned off (or non-default ports): it demands exactly the 7432+7433 listener pair, which a worker started with --lan false never opens
fix_direction: Read loopbackPort, lanPort and enableLan from the preserved settings.json and require only the listeners those settings imply (the loopback port alone when LAN is off), in both the pre-update check and the readiness loop, with a message naming the setting on mismatch.
